## What changed, and why

## Checked

- [ ] `cargo xtask ci` passes on this branch.
- [ ] **Another repository.** A change this one needs lands there first (the core, another app, the project's website or documentation), and what must follow this one has an issue there. Linked here, or "none":
- [ ] **What a user will see.** The guide and `CHANGELOG.md` say it, or "nothing":
- [ ] **Brand files** (logo, icons, palette) are untouched, or were changed at their source and copied from there.
- [ ] **Nothing private**: no person's name, email, account, machine detail, secret or private writing, in the files or the commits.
